### Top Boutique Hotels in SoHo

SoHo’s boutique hotels are design powerhouses. They tend to have active public spaces, buzz-worthy lobby bars, and prime step-out access to luxury shopping.

### Neighborhood Overview: Vibe & Kid-Friendliness

### Greenwich Village: Ideal for Atmosphere & Local Living

Greenwich Village feels like a real neighborhood where people live. Kids will love the street performers and playgrounds at Washington Square Park, as well as the famous bakeries (like Magnolia Bakery).

SoHo is world-famous for shopping and dining. While it feels less "neighborhood-y" than the Village, **SoHo has a much better selection of upscale hotels that cater specifically to families needing extra space.**
